evidence: Restaurant detail page for "The Golden Fork" shows name, cuisine (French), rating (4.5), review count (2), address (142 Grand Avenue, Downtown), price range ($$$$), description, and dining features (Private Dining, Wine Pairing, Tasting Menu). Home grid also shows cuisine, price, rating, location, features per restaurant.
Search by name (Sakura→1 result), by neighborhood (Downtown→1 result), and combined cuisine=American BBQ + price=$$ + search=Ember all correctly narrowed to Ember & Smoke only.

issue: Missing/invalid reservation info is not identified to the user
actual: Clicking "Confirm Reservation" with no date/time selected and empty required fields produced no visible error, message, or field highlighting. Repeating with Name, invalid email ("notanemail"), and Phone filled but no date/time still produced no feedback. The page text remained unchanged and no reservation was created (Upcoming (0)). The user has no way to know why submission failed or what to fix.

Applied coupon "WEEKEND20" (labeled as a weekend-only discount) on a Friday (Aug 28, 2026, confirmed via Date API), a non-weekend date, with 2 guests. The coupon was accepted and a -20% off discount was shown, when it should have been rejected for not meeting the weekend-day eligibility condition. (Party-size eligibility for GROUP15 was correctly enforced: applying GROUP15 with only 2 guests, below the stated 6+ guest minimum, was correctly rejected with no discount applied.)

evidence: Booked The Golden Fork for Aug 28, 2026 at 19:00, 2 guests, with contact info. Confirmation toast + confirmation card appeared immediately ("Reservation Confirmed!"). Reservation appears in Upcoming (1) with all supplied details.

Applied WELCOME10 coupon, saw "-10% off" discount, was able to remove it (Apply button reappeared, field cleared), then re-applied WELCOME10 and submitted; resulting reservation in Upcoming list shows "Coupon applied: WELCOME10".

Date picker disabled all past dates and today (through Aug 26, 2026); future dates from Aug 27 onward were selectable. Selected Aug 28, 2026 combined with time slot 19:00 and successfully submitted the reservation.

issue: Date cannot be changed when modifying a reservation
actual: The "Modify Reservation" dialog only offers "New Time" and "Party Size" selectors; there is no date field or date picker in the modify dialog. Time (19:00→20:00) and party size (2→4 Guests) changes saved and were reflected in the reservation list, but the reservation's date (August 28, 2026) cannot be modified at all through the UI.

evidence: Clicked Cancel, confirmed via "Cancel Reservation?" dialog. Reservation immediately removed from Upcoming (0) and appears in Past (1) with status "Cancelled" and all original details retained.

Modify dialog opened via "Modify" button, changes to time/party-size saved via "Save Changes" and reflected immediately. Cancel required explicit confirmation via "Cancel Reservation?" alertdialog with "Keep Reservation" / "Cancel Reservation" choices before the cancellation took effect.

Creation showed a toast ("Reservation Confirmed!") plus confirmation card, and the reservation appeared in Upcoming without reload. Modification (time/party size) updated the displayed card instantly. Cancellation instantly moved the reservation from Upcoming to Past with Cancelled status, all within the same session with no manual reload.

Upcoming vs Past/Cancelled distinguished via tabs (Upcoming (0)/Past (1)) and a status badge ("Upcoming"/"Cancelled"). Each reservation card displays restaurant name, date, time, party size, status, location (Downtown), and applied coupon ("Coupon applied: WELCOME10") when present.

Submitted a 5-star review with visit date, name, and comment for The Golden Fork. New review appeared in that restaurant's review list only (Reviews count 2→3); other restaurants (e.g. Sakura Garden) show only their own reviews.

issue: Review submission not restricted to completed reservations
actual: Submitted a review for The Golden Fork despite having no completed reservation there (the only reservation made for it had status "Cancelled", not completed). The review form had no eligibility check, showed no warning, and accepted the review, incrementing the review count from 2 to 3. This violates the constraint that a review may only be submitted for a restaurant covered by a completed reservation.

issue: Rating/review-count inconsistent between restaurant list and details; review submission doesn't update all summaries
actual: Restaurant detail page for The Golden Fork initially showed rating 4.5 (2) reviews, but the home restaurants list showed 4.8 for the same restaurant — a mismatch before any new review was added. After submitting a new 5-star review, the detail page recomputed to 4.7 (3), but the home page grid still displayed the stale 4.8 rating, unchanged. The homepage summary was not updated by the new review.
